planets.name: LHS 1140 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of LHS 1140 with a 3.78-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: LHS 1140 c was found in 2018 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around LHS 1140. Its orbit and size follow Cadieux et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
